## Academic Projects

::: {.cvsec}
[Academic projects]{.cvsec-label}

::: {}
::: {.cv-row}
::: {}
[Master's Dissertation --- The Ethics of Seeing: Contextual Moderation of Altered Image Acceptability]{.cv-role}
[University of Hull, United Kingdom]{.cv-org}

-   Conducted end-to-end research workflow: study setup, piloting, launch, monitoring recruitment progress, and exporting a clean analysis-ready dataset.
-   Recruited 700+ participants via Prolific and administered participant payments/approvals to ensure timely compensation.
-   Conducted complex multi-level Structural Equation Modelling analysis to elucidate key processes behind acceptability of altered images.
:::

[Sep 2024 — Sep 2025]{.cv-when}
:::

::: {.cv-row}
::: {}
[Honours Thesis --- Digital Age and Elderly Well-Being: Internet Use, Social Participation, and Life Satisfaction]{.cv-role}
[Nanyang Technological University, Singapore]{.cv-org}

-   Integrated concepts from psychology, gerontology, and digital literacy to conceptualize a moderated mediation model to analyse the social mechanisms between internet use and life satisfaction among the elderly.
-   Probed the examination of a new dimension of internet use: "Variety of internet use", and its connections to the proposed model.
-   Executed secondary analysis on the publicly available English Longitudinal Study of Ageing (ELSA).
:::

[Aug 2023 — Jun 2024]{.cv-when}
:::

::: {.cv-row}
::: {}
[URECA --- Examining the effects of a scheduling nudge for freshmen undergraduates]{.cv-role}
[Nanyang Technological University, Singapore]{.cv-org}

-   Utilized Qualtrics and Experience Sampling Method (ESM) to create an innovative experimental survey design.
-   Self-taught "R" analysis software to conduct data cleaning and complex analysis.
-   Administrated the collection of 1000+ data points for data analysis.
:::

[Sep 2022 — Aug 2023]{.cv-when}
